query: What is the latest United States jurisdiction to legalize the recreational use of cannabis?

results.title: Cannabis Legalization Timeline — State by State History
results.content:
Colorado and Washington were the first states to legalize adult-use (recreational) cannabis, both via voter initiative in November 2012 , with retail sales launching January 1, 2014 in Colorado.
24 states plus Washington DC have legalized adult-use cannabis as of 2026.

results.title: Legality of cannabis by U.S. jurisdiction - Wikipedia
results.content: The recreational use of cannabis has been legalized in 24 states, three U.S. territories, and D.C.[b] Another seven states have decriminalized its use.[c] Commercial distribution has been legalized in all jurisdictions where possession has been legalized, except for Virginia and D.C.

results.title: Where Is Cannabis Legal? A Guide To All 50 States
results.content:
Where Is Cannabis Legal?
With Georgia becoming the 41st state to allow medical marijuana sales, three more could legalize some form of cannabis sales in 2026.
Hawaii was the first state to legalize medical marijuana through the state legislature in 2000 but has not been able to legalize a recreational market.

results.title: The Divided States of Cannabis | Cannabis Regulation
results.content:
It’s been nearly 30 years since California made history as the first state to legalize medical cannabis.
Since then, 40 states have passed laws to legalize cannabis to some extent – whether for medical or recreational use – and continue to refine, redefine, or in some cases undo their regulations.

results.title: Marijuana can be sold for recreational use in Virginia starting in 2027 | AP News
results.content:
becoming the first Southern state to legalize possession of marijuana, Virginia has approved a legal way to sell it to recreational users.
State budget legislation enacted Monday will allow up to 350 cannabis shops to open across Virginia beginning July 1, 2027.
